reply_lines: Did you know? Computers do about a billion math steps every second!
That is way faster than any person could ever count.
Did you know adding is the most basic thing a computer does?
Even big AI helpers are just doing math super fast!
Math rules never change — 2 + 2 is always 4.
Computers love that! No surprises, just rules.
Did you know? The first robot brains were just math steps on paper!
Real thinkers turned those paper steps into modern computers.
